package.question: Does Method M produce news summaries that follow a requested discourse structure more closely than prompting-based LLM baselines, and does this come at a cost in content accuracy?
package.methods_summary: The task is to summarize a news article into a sequence of sentences that each play a requested discourse role (e.g., introductory element, contextual detail, source attribution). A sentence-level discourse classifier, trained on Dataset D and reported at over 90% validation accuracy, guides generation. Method M (beam variant) writes the summary one target role at a time: LLaMa-3-8B proposes candidate sentences (beam size 16) and the classifier keeps those that best match the target role. Method M (edit variant) drafts a full summary and repeatedly regenerates sentences whose predicted role is wrong.
package.experimental_setup: Data: Dataset D, news articles paired with social-media and newsletter summaries labelled with sentence-level discourse roles; target role sequences are sampled randomly per generation. Baselines: DeepSeek-V3, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, GPT-4o, Qwen-2.5 and LLaMa-3-8B prompted directly (the paper states that vanilla generation keeps the best of 16 samples according to the same classifier), plus LLaMa-3-8B fine-tuned with PEFT on Dataset D. Metrics: ROUGE-L, FactCC and AlignScore for content; Match Score, Levenshtein distance and LCS between predicted and target role sequences, using either the automatic classifier or two human annotators.

results_tables.caption: Structure-controlled news summarization on the test data of Dataset D (the paper's new news-summary dataset). Content accuracy: ROUGE-L (%), FactCC, AlignScore. Structural adherence to the target discourse-label sequence: Match Score (MS) and Levenshtein distance (Lev), computed from labels assigned by the automatic discourse labeler ('Auto') or by human annotators ('Human').
results_tables.notes: Dropped: O1 row (several metrics missing) and the two LCS columns (automatic and human). '-' = not reported in the source. Bold/underline markers not reproduced. Single run per system; no variance or significance tests reported. Human structural labels come from two annotators on 100 summaries per model.

Human-preference MRR and beam-size results are figures and were not used. Abstract, results prose and conclusion withheld.
